findings.issue: Common noun הָאָרֶז (H730) is transliterated as erez instead of a Spanish common noun.
Common noun הָאֵזֹב (H231) is transliterated as ezov instead of a Spanish common noun.
Construct שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת (H8144 + H8438 b) is collapsed into one noun, so the second scarlet token is not separately visible.
Qal טָבַל (H2881) is dip/immerse; mojar is primarily wet. mojar en may only smooth that force.

notes: Take, 3mp them, blood, slaughtered bird, living waters, sprinkle toward the house, and seven times match the tokens.
